title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #2 BATTLEPLAN UNDERDAWN OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #2 BATTLEPLAN UNDERDAWN OPEN

SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Contracts" to clear stages. By completing tests, players can increase their Sanctuary Judgment scores and collect "Crystal Contract Bounty" (used to exchange for rewards in the Crystallization Sanctuary). Upon completing certain "Contracts," players can also earn rewards such as the exclusive outfit for Plume, Integrated Module Data Chunk, and exclusive furniture.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Crystal Contract Bounty. Crystal Contract Bounty can be used to redeem items in Crystallization Sanctuary.
MAIN REWARDS: Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Kal'tsit / Pozëmka / Jessica the Liberated / Executor the Ex Foedere
★★★★★: La Pluma / Wind Chimes / Firewhistle/ Kazemaru / Poncirus / Corroserum
03 NEW PACK S AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Module Data Block * 24, Data Supplement Instrument * 30, Data Supplement Stick * 90
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
Please stay tuned for more information!
